issue_context.title: GOAWAY may cause client error when client request server in high concurrency
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:

We enabled [GOAWAY](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/88567) feature in our large-scale cluster, and we found client(Kubelet) may got error(500 http code response) like `request declared a Content-Length of N but only wrote 0 bytes` after received GOAWAY frame. 

I had already re-produce this bug and open an [issue](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/39086) in golang repo. So far I think this bug only occur with a small probability when client request server in high concurrency use a same httpclient instance, and it's a golang sdk bug in http client.

**Before I solved this issue, I suggest do NOT enable GOAWAY(`--goaway-chance=0`) feature. As it's a golang sdk bug(currently I known and doubt) in http client, revert GOAWAY feature(codes) is not necessary.**
comments:
> Before I solved this issue, I suggest do NOT enable GOAWAY(`--goaway-chance=0`) feature. As it's a golang sdk bug(currently I known and doubt) in http client, revert GOAWAY feature(codes) is not necessary.

Based on https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/release-1.18/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/options/server_run_options.go#L57 not setting the field, I think it defaults that way, so that's good.

We will leave the option and filter so that when golang updates its client, we will have a simple way to turn it on and execute it.

Sure.

I am trying to fix the golang http client issue and will update progress at [golang issue](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/32441). After golang http client issue fixed, I will add more concurrent test cases to see if there are any other bugs may occur by GOAWAY feature.

BTW, we still enable GOAWAY feature in our production cluster, because there is no any evidence told us this error will influence SLO, as all most components(kubelet, controller-manager, scheduler) is controller work mode and will re-try after got error.

/assign
Golang version [1.13.13](https://github.com/golang/go/milestone/149) or [1.14.5](https://github.com/golang/go/milestone/150) required, which will release at 07/01/2020.

Kubernetes v1.19(or master branch) now is using golang 1.15, and golang 1.15 has fixed the issue. And [Kubernetes v1.18 backport golang 1.15](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/94037) is on going.

Let me add more test cases to ensure the error will not happen again.

I think we should re-open this issue because of https://github.com/golang/go/issues/41234 .

/re-open

review_comments: this test fails 100% of the time when run with `go test -race k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/filters -run TestGOAWAYConcurrency`, disabling in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/94529 and opened https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/94532 to track fixing the test or the component
caused by golang http/http2 pkg, I have already opened an issue [#41234 at golang repo](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/41234) .
this added a data race on unguarded localAddr, fixed in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/94530

As far as I know, it's not the root cause of TestClientReceivedGOAWAY flake, because dial a new connection only when client send a new request, and in this case, requests are sent one by one. In other words, if this line cause data race, then the additional unexpected connection set up, which means the test case or the configuration has problem.

I'm still debug the root cause of TestClientReceivedGOAWAY flake, for now, I doubt that I used an incorrect http2 server/client configuration(`http.Transport.MaxConnsPerHost=1` or SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS limited), or the dial function ignored context.Context which will cause more than one goroutine dial the connection when the first canceled.

Another interesting thing is I got a data race result that read at `if tc.expectConnections != len(localAddr)`(main testing goroutine)  and write at `localAddr = append(localAddr, conn.LocalAddr().String())`, I'm very confused why the client try to set-up a new connection when we finished all requests.
